title: The statement of an account: the balance before the first day, the grand total of a group as a net, the accounts a group statement lists, and the employee filter

opening_balance.note: From the 25th of October the customer 12041003 stands at 6,356.06 debit before the period, the period debits 115.00 and credits 90.00, and the balance after is 6,381.06

grand_total.note: The total line of a group statement carries in the two balance columns the net of debit less credit, not the sum of the balances: 7,336.06 debit and nothing on credit for the customers, 0.00 for the whole company

display_choices.note: For the customers group from the 25th to the 27th of October: all accounts gives 4, the accounts with transactions in the period 1, and the choice named accounts with transactions but behaving as a balance that is not nil 3, two of them with an opening of 725.00 and 230.00 and no line in the period

employee_filter.note: Added by works in the statement: employee 1 returns every line, employee 0 and employee 999 return nothing with the message that nothing matches the choices

cases.reason: The reference system lists the account of every customer under its choice of all accounts, so it names customers that hold nothing here. A statement here never names a party that holds nothing in the branches it adds up, so the customer with no opening balance and no line is left out of that choice.

The reference system answers an employee of 0 with nothing. Here an empty or zero employee means no filter at all, so the filter can be cleared by choosing nobody; an employee who is not one, or who added no line, gives the empty statement with the message that nothing matches.

inputs.statement: every line of the account, added by one employee
